Subject: POC Observability Onboarding & Checklist for Nimbus Analytics

Hi Olivia / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps to get the trial (POC) started: 

Summary of scope
- Goal: Validate Redwood Inference for production-level observability on latency, cost, and quality for your user-facing summarization pipeline (internal model + third-party embedding store).
- Duration: 3-week trial (pilot), with a focused 2-week active evaluation window.
- Key deliverables: live dashboards, tracing enabled for request flows, exported logs to your S3, and a short evaluative report with recommendations.

Proposed success criteria (we can refine):
1) Latency: 95th percentile tail latency under 300ms for 512-token generation on our dedicated test traffic.
2) Reliability: Error rate <= 0.5% during the evaluation window on synthetic and sampled production traffic.
3) Cost efficiency: Achieve >=20% lower cost-per-1k-tokens compared to your current endpoint when using Redwood batching + caching settings.
4) Observability completeness: Dashboards for latency, tokens-in/out, error classes, batching efficiency, and KV cache hit rate; traces for request lifecycles end-to-end.

Owners & initial timeline
- Redwood: Vivek (technical lead, instrumentation & dashboard shipping), me (engagement lead).
- Nimbus: Olivia (product owner), Tom (infrastructure).
- Kickoff: Mon Aug 24 — 30-minute technical onboarding.
- Instrumentation window: Aug 25–Aug 28.
- Active evaluation: Aug 31–Sep 11.

Observability asks for you before kickoff
- Provide a read-only S3 bucket or temporary credentials for log export.
- Short list of 3 representative prompt sets and one high-volume endpoint to mirror traffic.
- If possible, enable OpenTelemetry exporter for your gateway (optional but helpful).

Attachments: poc-observability-checklist.xlsx (initial checklist) and redwood-poc-architecture.png (high-level network/infra).

Please reply with any edits to the success criteria or owners. If that timeline looks good, we’ll send a calendar invite for the kickoff and a short Drive doc with the onboarding checklist.

Thanks —
Karthik

Olivia — great, thanks for the confirmation. We’ll add the fidelity criterion (<=3% regression on your QA set) to the success metrics. Below are concrete observability items we’ll deliver during the POC and what we need from Nimbus to validate them.

What Redwood will deliver (observable outputs)
- Out-of-the-box dashboards (hosted in Redwood Console):
  1) POC / Nimbus Overview: tokens in/out, per-request token cost, cumulative cost, total requests.
  2) Latency dashboard: P50 / P95 / P99, request duration histogram, tail-latency trends.
  3) Reliability & errors: 5xx/4xx trend, per-code breakdown, request-level error logs linked to traces.
  4) Efficiency & batching: average batch size, batch wait time distribution, batching throughput.
  5) Caching & reuse: KV cache hit rate, prefix reuse percentage, cache hit latency.

- Tracing & correlating logs: We’ll enable distributed tracing for the request lifecycle. Traces will include: gateway -> Redwood routing -> model exec -> embed store calls. We’ll also link traces to request logs for quick investigation (OpenTelemetry compatible).

- Log export: We will stream structured logs (json-lines) to your provided S3 bucket daily. Log fields include request_id, timestamp, route, model_variant, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, latency_ms, error_code (if any), batch_id, cache_hit_bool.

- Alerting & runbooks: We’ll set up basic alerts (P95 > 500ms, error rate > 1%, cost burn rate > 2x expected) with short runbooks pinned to each alert.

Validation plan & tests
- Synthetic replay: Redwood will run a controlled replay of 20k requests (mirror traffic shape) to measure baseline metrics.
- Production sample: We'll sample 1% of live traffic for full tracing (no PII extraction) — requires your approval.
- Fidelity test: We will run your 200-item QA prompt set nightly and compute regression vs your baseline.

Ownership & contacts
- Instrumentation & dashboards: Vivek Kulkarni (vivek@redwood.ai).
- Cost & batching tuning: Laura Bennett (laura@redwood.ai).
- Contracts / SOW / NDAs: Monica Patel (monica@redwood.ai) — Monica, can you confirm the standard NDA/SOW cadence so we don’t block kickoff?

Action items for Nimbus (before kickoff)
- Provide S3 write credentials or an IAM role.
- Share the 200-item QA set and 3 prompt sets by Thu Aug 22.
- Confirm whether OTEL exporter can be enabled (Tom).

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/987654321), onboarding doc (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c4d-poc-observability-plan).

Attachments: updated poc-observability-checklist.xlsx and redwood-poc-architecture.png.

If that all looks good I’ll schedule the kickoff and send calendar invites.
